name: EPIC 212531988
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 17, 15.4 solar radii and 1.00 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212531988 (K2 campaign 17): PARAM radius (solar radii) 15.392495 (16th-84th percentiles 14.420335-16.491485), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212531988 (K2 campaign 17): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.004337 (16th-84th percentiles 0.868617-1.170861), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212531988: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4650.07 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212531988 (K2 campaign 17): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3693.046875 (16th-84th percentiles 3508.398438-3887.617188), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.23 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,693 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 1.00 solar masses and 15.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,650 K at its surface.
